# Linear Model for Spatial GDP

For this model, we will use two basics training and testing datasets:

* `prediction_dataset.csv`: For prediction purposes

* `regression_dataset.csv`: For training and regression purposes

### Load dataset
```{r}
# Regression Dataset
regression_data = read.csv("regression_dataset.csv")

# Prediction Dataset
prediction_data = read.csv("prediction_dataset.csv")
```
